description: This file defines a Flutter widget named CheckMark, which displays a circular avatar with a checkmark SVG icon inside. It is part of a UI component library for an e-commerce app.

classes.name: CheckMark
classes.description: A stateless Flutter widget representing a check mark inside a circular avatar, customizable with colors, radius, and padding.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the CheckMark widget, returning a CircleAvatar with an SVG checkmark inside.
